Mick Jones had been explaining to anyone who would listen that his training at Ockley Court Farm took place on a smooth concrete pad distanced some 75 metres from the nearest strawberry bed. So Mike's claim to fame was to reach the strawberries.

Mike's 75.20 came in the first round and he followed up with four more throws over 70 metres and a final effort just a foot short of the 70m arc. 100m: 2.8 1, D.Chambers (Eng) 10.17; 5, C.Lambert (GBJ) 10.46. 400m: 3, G.Dearman (GBS) 46.40; c 1, M.Parper (gst) 48.96. 1500m: 2, S.Barden (Lough) 3:44.…

Mike's injury forced his withdrawal from the following week's European Cup. 1, M.Jones 74.98; 2, P.Spivey 57.98; 3, J.Osazuwa 57.85. 11 Trafford GP, Longford Park, Stretford. 1500m: 7, R.Hayman 4:06.10.

At the Crawley Open Meet on the evening of 6th September Mike launched his hammer out to 75.94 to exceed the Olympic Qualifying distance by 44 centimetres and increase his Club and Personal Record by 96cm.

He was well pleased - as was veteran Mike Trees who spends as much time jetting to and from Japan as he does in England. Mike narrowly had the beating of The Skipper (wearing a hopelessly short set of spikes) and suddenly, with news of others returning to training or featuring highly in other races,…
